_meta.title: the facade speaks and remembers
_meta.instruments: ring7_facade_probe.py + ring7_debug1*/2* (sandbox), ring6_ifr_probe.py machinery reused (pierce/FFS/PE32/direct_forms), opcode values parsed from edk2_UefiInternalFormRepresentation.h (tianocore master)
_meta.method: T1 length-prefixed blob model (prefix = package size + 4; no spec package list ships in the PE — HiiAddPackages builds it at runtime); T2 SIBT walk (ids sequential from 1, SKIP/DUPLICATE honored, multi-language en-US + fr-FR); T3 IFR dissection with scope stack (questions attach to forms, options/defaults to questions); T4 varstores and defaults; string resolution per forms package by best-coverage English-first pairing

_unresolved_structure.head: two records with opcode 0x00 (undefined in the current EDK2 UefiInternalFormRepresentation.h): {0x00,len=4,payload=24 24} then {0x00,len=41} followed by three free-floating ONE_OF_OPTIONs and two ENDs
_unresolved_structure.content: otherwise real IFR: DISABLE_IF/EQ_ID_VAL/TEXT pairs, a CHECKBOX, a DATE and a TIME question (varstore id 1 = SECUREBOOT_CONFIGURATION), SUBTITLEs, REFs, and a scoped FORM (id 0x15, title 0x0d) whose scope does not close inside the package
_unresolved_structure.accounting: 6 question-class opcode occurrences counted by the flat histogram (ring 6: secboot total 208) are NOT structurally attached by the facade walk (202) — the difference is exactly these 6, fully located, no interpretation forced
